question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank No. 3.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3)**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage explains **the solemn atmosphere of the room and provides reasons for it.**
 
• The **appropriate word **should logically connect the idea of being solemn with the reason it is so seldom entered.
 
• "**Because**" fits well as it directly provides a causal explanation, which aligns with the context..

Therefore, the correct sentence from the passage should read **"****it was silent, because remote from the nursery and kitchen; solemn, because__ it was known to be so seldom entered.........."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Other options ("however", "perhaps", "as") do not fit the context as well

 
• **However **(हालांकि): "However" introduces a contrast or an exception, which is not needed here.
 
• **Perhaps **(शायद): "Perhaps" indicates uncertainty or speculation, which does not fit a definitive reason.
 
• **As **(जैसा कि): "As" would work in some contexts, but it is less direct and slightly redundant following a similar structure in the sentence.
